context: Use the Parquet tables under data/. See context/description.md for file paths, field descriptions. Hints are optional and selected by the experiment configuration.
query: For LGG patients, compute the average log10-transformed expression of the IGF2 gene across different histology types. Only include patients with valid IGF2 expression values and histology annotations that are not enclosed in square brackets. Report the final average values with at least four decimal places of precision.
